list.name: run_id
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT run_id FROM ofm_load_test_runs ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 100

targets.rawSql: SELECT timestamp, service, operation, message, trace_id, span_id, raw FROM ofm_logs WHERE test_run_id='$run_id' AND architecture='microservice' AND level='error' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 500
